verdicts.reason: Both have broken hierarchy: the supporting line 'with your next cup of coffee' is far bigger than the 'GET A GIFT' headline. In both, the gift icons, oversized stars, 'Only this Christmas' and the URL sit as unreadably tiny fragments on the busy sweater photo. A at least keeps the LYGOM CAFE logo and cup on the pink field next to the headline (tiny, but legible). B pushes the logo to the far right edge on top of the busy photo, where it is illegible, so the brand is effectively lost.
